column1: #deck:Via dei Tigli::Chapter 022 · Skills and abilities; people and places you know

column2: “Do you know how to swim?” Lucia asks.
column4: to know (a fact, how to do something) — sapere + a fact, or sapere + infinitive: so nuotare.
to know (a person, a place, a thing) — conoscere + a person or a place: conosco Lucia.

column2: “Yes, I know how to drive,” Chiara says.
“Do you know how to play the guitar?” Lucia asks.
“But do you know how to teach?” Lucia asks.
